canonical_statement: The study evaluated whether PNU-142300 and PNU-142586 could be quantified in saliva and characterized serum and salivary pharmacokinetics of linezolid and its two major metabolites after a single intravenous dose in healthy adults.

canonical_statement: Serum and saliva samples were stored at -80 C until analysis; serum protein-unbound concentrations were obtained after ultrafiltration, while saliva was quantified without ultrafiltration under the assumption that salivary protein binding was minimal.

canonical_statement: Linezolid, PNU-142300, and PNU-142586 were quantified in serum and saliva by HPLC; LLOQ was 0.1 microg/mL for linezolid and PNU-142300 and 0.2 microg/mL for PNU-142586.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The lower limit of quantification (LLOQ) was 0.1 μg/mL for LZD and PNU-142300 and 0.2 μg/mL for PNU-142586.

canonical_statement: Noncompartmental pharmacokinetic analysis defined time zero as infusion start, Cmax as the highest observed concentration, Tmax from infusion start, calculated AUC0-10 by the trapezoidal rule, and estimated AUC0-infinity as AUC0-10 plus Ct/ke.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: AUCs from 0 to 10 h ... were calculated using the trapezoidal rule ... AUC0–∞ = AUC0–10 + Ct/ke

canonical_statement: Protein binding ratio was estimated from total and unbound serum concentrations and calculated at each participant's Cmax as ([total - unbound]/total) x 100.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: PB (%) was calculated as ([total concentration − unbound concentration]/total concentration) × 100 using total and unbound concentrations at the time of Cmax for each participant

canonical_statement: The in silico analysis predicted linezolid to be predominantly molecular at salivary pH 6.8 and blood pH 7.4, whereas PNU-142300 and PNU-142586 were predicted to be predominantly ionized at those pH values.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: LZD exists predominantly in the molecular form at salivary pH 6.8 and blood pH 7.4. In contrast, PNU-142300 and PNU-142586 ... [were predicted] to exist predominantly in ionized forms at these pH values.

canonical_statement: The single intravenous dose in six healthy volunteers may not represent multiple-dose or steady-state pharmacokinetics in clinical practice, particularly metabolite accumulation in renal impairment.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The single intravenous dose in a small number of healthy volunteers may not reflect the pharmacokinetic behaviour under multiple-dose or steady-state conditions encountered in clinical practice, particularly with respect to metabolite accumulation in renally impaired patients.

canonical_statement: Because both metabolites were below quantification in all saliva samples, a saliva-to-serum concentration ratio could not be estimated and an effect of analytical sensitivity could not be excluded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: because both metabolites were BLQ in all saliva samples in the present study, this ratio could not be estimated, and the influence of analytical sensitivity cannot be entirely excluded.

canonical_statement: The terminal elimination phase of the metabolite serum profiles was insufficiently characterized during the 0-10 hour single-dose sampling period, so elimination rates and multiple-dose accumulation could not be projected.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the terminal elimination phase of the serum concentration–time profiles of the metabolites was insufficiently characterized during the 0–10 h single-dose sampling period. Consequently, the elimination rate and extent of accumulation under multiple-dose conditions could not be projected

canonical_statement: Salivary pH and flow rate were not systematically evaluated as factors affecting salivary drug distribution.

canonical_statement: All participants were male, limiting characterization of sex-related differences in salivary pharmacokinetics.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All participants were male ... Future studies including female participants are warranted to fully characterize any sex-related differences in the salivary pharmacokinetics of linezolid metabolites.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that salivary linezolid concentrations closely reflected serum-unbound exposure after a single intravenous dose in healthy adults.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Salivary concentrations of LZD closely reflect serum-unbound exposure following a single intravenous dose in healthy adults.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that PNU-142300 and PNU-142586 remained below the assay quantification limit in saliva despite quantifiable serum exposure, so blood-based measurements were required to assess metabolite exposure under the studied conditions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Despite quantifiable serum exposure, the two major metabolites, PNU-142300 and PNU-142586, remained below the lower limit of quantification in all saliva samples ... whereas blood-based measurements were required to assess exposure to its major metabolites under the conditions of the present study.

canonical_statement: The authors considered the findings supportive of further evaluation of salivary monitoring for linezolid.
